item.title: Exact Copy App Ad

exact_text: Plan your day in one place.

turns.text: Create a silent 9-second 16:9 ad for my fictional planning app DayNest. Three equal-length scenes with these exact lines, one per scene in this order: 'Less scrolling. More doing.' / 'Plan your day in one place.' / 'Try DayNest today.' Keep capitals and punctuation exactly. No other visible words, even in the background. Use simple animated calendar and checkmark shapes on cream and green.

item.tests: Renders exact ordered on-screen copy with correct punctuation and no extraneous text in a landscape app ad.

Only those lines appear as visible text, legibly and without altered capitalization or punctuation.
The video is silent and uses cream-and-green calendar and checkmark animation.

args.name: DayNest — Cream and Green Silent Ad

style.prompt: Create a SILENT 9-second 16:9 minimalist motion-graphics concept advertisement for the fictional planning app DayNest. Exactly three consecutive scenes, each exactly 3 seconds long: scene 1 from 0.000 to 3.000 seconds; scene 2 from 3.000 to 6.000 seconds; scene 3 from 6.000 to 9.000 seconds. Flat vector design, warm cream background (#F7F3E8), forest-green (#275D43) and soft sage-green shapes. Simple clean animated calendar icons and checkmark shapes only, with gentle easing and ample negative space. Static camera, no live action, no complex app interface. All calendar grids must be purely geometric, with absolutely no numbers, letters, weekday labels or tiny text. Exact typography is critically important. Display ONLY the following line for each scene, preserving spelling, capitals and punctuation exactly; no quotation marks. Scene 1: Less scrolling. More doing. Scene 2: Plan your day in one place. Scene 3: Try DayNest today. Each line should appear in large, crisp, centered dark-green sans-serif typography, fully readable and held stable throughout its entire three-second scene. Scene 1: a simple cream-and-green calendar icon with a few geometric tiles that gently settle into place, text 'Less scrolling. More doing.' Scene 2: a single organized calendar grid with a green checkmark drawing itself, text 'Plan your day in one place.' Scene 3: a satisfying large green checkmark beside a small calendar silhouette, text 'Try DayNest today.' Use clean hard cuts exactly at seconds 3 and 6, no overlapping text between scenes, no fade to black. No other visible words anywhere, no separate logo lettering, no subtitles, no numbers, no background text, no extra taglines, no watermarks or labels. Absolutely silent: no voice, music, sound effects or audio track.
